I stopped without changing anything, because this project has no `_codev/`. Run `codev init` first, then come back to `/codev-configure`.

`codev status --json` failed with `no_codev_root`, and the project root has only `README.md`, `index.js`, `package.json`, `.claude/` and `.git/`. The skill doesn't create `_codev/config.yaml` from scratch. So I didn't explore the project, didn't draft a `context:`/`rules:` patch, and never reached the confirmation question.

Separately, the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings before you can use them. This task didn't need any of them.
